mission: 'A 3-month online research program from January to April 2027, where participants form teams to work on preselected projects.' Project leads propose research — or, unusually, projects 'to stop harmful AI developments' such as organising tech workers — and select their own team members. Editions began in person in 2018 (Las Palmas, Prague, Madrid) and have been virtual since 2020. Organisers include Remmelt Ellen.

warnings.text: Some harmful AI developments should be actively stopped, not just studied (AISC now accepts such projects).

recommendations.text: Let experienced people lead small remote teams on AI safety projects, lowering barriers for newcomers to contribute.
